messages:
Anita (PM): quick sync — customer asks coming from two pilots: want (1) per-route quantization suggestions, (2) eval-triggered alerting on quality regressions, and (3) a simple UI toggle to opt into batching/caching recommendations. can we scope an MVP?
Mike (Eng): high level: per-route quant recs = model + workload profile -> offline scoring + runtime guardrails. biggest infra work is safe fallback when quant harms quality.
Jordan (ML): agree. for MVP we can provide "recommendations" not automated rollout. recommendation payload: model, quant-level, expected token-speed delta, estimated quality delta.
Riley (SE): customers want the recs surfaced in Console + API. example API call they expect: `POST /v1/optimize/recs {"route_id": "r-123","signals": {...}}`
Sasha (ProdOps): rollout constraints: Dedicated customers require per-tenant KMS + audit log on any quant change. Private customers may need air-gapped export of recs.
customer-ops-bot: FYI — Pilot A asked for manual approval flow and webhook for when recs change. Pilot B wants eval-alerts tied to their gold prompts.
Anita (PM): propose MVP scope (narrow):
- Recs: per-route UI + API that lists 3 ranked quant profiles (int8, int4, fp16) with estimated latency/cost/quality deltas
- Eval alerts: hook to existing eval runner; trigger notifications to Slack + webhook when median F1 drops >5% over 24h on selected prompt set
- Batching/caching: passive recommendations only (no forced batching). show expected SLO impact and toggle to enable suggested config
Mike (Eng): implementation notes:
- offline job: run recs w/ sampled traces -> produce candidate list
- runtime: add soft-reroute guard: if quant rec leads to >X% token-error or latency spike, auto-fallback to baseline
- engineering estimate: 3 sprints core + 1 sprint integrations (console, webhooks)
Jordan (ML): eval-alert rule prototype (pseudo):
```
rule {
  name: "eval-regression-route-r-123"
  metric: "median_f1"
  window: "24h"
  threshold: "drop > 5% vs baseline"
  actions: ["slack:#cs-pilot-alerts","webhook:https://cust.example/webhook"]
}
```
Riley (SE): can we make the UI show uncertainty bands for estimated quality? customers asked. even a simple +/- range is fine.
Sasha (ProdOps): can we list launch blockers? I see: tenant RBAC for rec approvals, audit log entries, and an opt-out policy for auto-fallback.
Anita (PM): launch criteria suggestion (MVP):
- Feature: recs appear in Console + API and are generated for 3 sample routes
- Safety: runtime guardrails active and fallback tested on staging traffic
- Observability: eval-alerts firing to Slack/webhook with synthetic regression test
- Security: RBAC and KMS flags validated for at least one Dedicated customer
Mike (Eng): prioritization ask: do we treat eval-alerts as independent MVP? they touch eval infra but are smaller scope than recs.
Anita (PM): yes — split workstreams: (A) recs + fallback (priority), (B) eval-alerts plumbing + rule UI (parallel), (C) batching-toggle display (low lift).
customer-ops-bot: Pilot A will accept if recs + manual approval + webhook exist. Pilot B will only sign if eval-alerts integrate with their prompt set.
Jordan (ML): data needed from SEs: 1) representative prompt sets per route, 2) typical sequence length distribution, 3) recent latency percentiles.
Riley (SE): sending artifacts this afternoon.
Sasha (ProdOps): I'll create a rollout checklist doc and attach to the PR: RBAC, audit logs, fallback smoke tests, integration test for eval alerts.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: staging/optimize-recs -> 2764822100 (canary).
Anita (PM): next steps: Mike/Jordan produce rough tech spec by EOD Fri, Sasha to draft rollout checklist, Riley to collect customer traces. we'll reconvene Tue for final scope cut. :raised_hands:
